# COMMON PANTRY — fixed client records

## Existing identity

- Identity source: 03-common-pantry-logo.png.
- Complete master: basket symbol plus COMMON PANTRY wordmark.
- Master ink: deep green, nominal #244E3D.
- Source background: plain white field, separate from the mark.
- Fixed master attributes: lettering, symbol, arrangement, proportions and ink colour.
- Permitted master treatment: uniform scaling and placement on a light solid background.
- Master presentation: complete, upright, with original forms and ink appearance; visible bounds reserved for the master.
- Branch cue location: outside the complete master's visible bounds.
- Cooperative structure: Market Green and River Lane are branches of COMMON PANTRY.
- Master coverage: every application artwork; presentation document coverage at document level.

## Branch records

| Code | Exact branch name | Fascia width × height | Departments, in required directory order | Opening hours |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| MG | Market Green | 4800 × 800 mm | Fresh produce; Bread & dairy; Pantry staples; Household refills | Daily 08:00–20:00 |
| RL | River Lane | 2400 × 600 mm | Fresh produce; Bread & dairy; Pantry staples | Daily 09:00–19:00 |

- Dimension basis: specified fascia design envelopes.
- Access: members and non-members welcome at both branches.
- Household refills availability: Market Green only.
- Branch-specific artwork identifier: corresponding branch name in words.
- Required wording: exact words; variable capitalisation and line breaks.
- Ordinary label treatment: words, optionally accompanied by colour or symbols.
- MG and RL: reference codes; optional public copy.
- Membership fee, discount, delivery service, accreditation and reward balance: unspecified.
- Additional prices, addresses, web links, QR codes, environmental certifications and product-stock guarantees: unspecified.
- Supporting copy basis: supplied cooperative and branch facts.

## Public copy by application

| Application | Public content |
| --- | --- |
| Fascia | Complete master; exact branch name |
| Directory | Complete master; branch name; all corresponding departments in recorded order |
| Bag front | Complete master; branch name; "Good food. Shared ownership." |
| Membership card front | Complete master; branch name; "Cooperative member"; "Member 0042" |
| Window notice | Complete master; branch name; complete corresponding opening hours; "Everyone is welcome. Membership is optional." |

- Directory type: category directory.
- Directory spatial data: room positions, arrows and aisle numbers unspecified.
- Bag artwork scope: flat artwork for one side of each reusable bag.
- Good food. Shared ownership.: cooperative statement shared by both branches.
- Membership card status: sample face.
- Sample member: Member 0042 at both branches.
- Card access, payment, barcode and financial data: unspecified.
- Opening-hours notation: recorded days and times, with equivalent unambiguous English time formats permitted.
- Application content scope: the corresponding public-content row.
- Displayed facts across artwork, explanations and presentation pages: the same branch records and public wording.

steps.userMessage:
COMMON PANTRY | Two branches of one neighbourhood cooperative

We run COMMON PANTRY, a neighbourhood grocery cooperative, and need a branch identity system for Market Green and River Lane. Both shops welcome members and non-members. The supplied basket symbol and "COMMON PANTRY" wordmark form our complete master logo. Preserve its lettering, symbol, arrangement, proportions and deep green ink, nominal #244E3D. Use the complete master at a uniform scale on a light solid background, with branch cues placed outside its visible bounds. The two shops should read as branches of the same cooperative, with their names providing the clearest distinction.

Market Green has a 4800 × 800 mm fascia and four departments, in this directory order: Fresh produce; Bread & dairy; Pantry staples; Household refills. Its hours are Daily 08:00–20:00. River Lane has a 2400 × 600 mm fascia and three departments, in this order: Fresh produce; Bread & dairy; Pantry staples. Its hours are Daily 09:00–19:00. Household refills belongs to Market Green. Bag fronts carry the exact line "Good food. Shared ownership.". Membership card fronts carry the exact heading "Cooperative member" and sample field "Member 0042". Window notices carry the exact sentence "Everyone is welcome. Membership is optional.".

Audience: neighbourhood residents and cooperative members need to recognise their branch and its offer, while the cooperative team needs to approve a consistent system for both shops.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the existing identity rules, branch records and public wording. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable with its proportion, format and stage. 03-common-pantry-logo.png is the identity source containing the fixed complete master logo. 04-branch-fascia-envelopes.png is the constraint drawing of the two fascia dimensions. 05-neighbourhood-grocery-materials.png is an atmosphere reference for everyday grocery materials and a welcoming cooperative tone.

Deliverables:
1. A one-page branch specification stating the master logo treatment, #244E3D, both fascia dimensions, both department lists and the branch-name hierarchy
2. Two fascia artworks, one for Market Green at 4800 × 800 mm and one for River Lane at 2400 × 600 mm, each with the complete master and branch name
3. Two category directories, one per branch, each with the complete master, branch name and its departments in the stated order
4. Two reusable bag fronts as flat artwork, one per branch, each with the complete master, branch name and Good food. Shared ownership.
5. Two membership card fronts, one per branch, each with the complete master, branch name, Cooperative member and Member 0042
6. Two window notices, one per branch, each with the complete master, branch name, its full opening hours and Everyone is welcome. Membership is optional.
7. One four-page branch application guide covering master placement, branch-name hierarchy, the two fascia sizes and paired examples of all five application types
8. One 10-second video pairing the two fascias, then the two directories, and ending with both bag fronts and Good food. Shared ownership.
9. One presentation document of at least eight pages reusing the specification, all ten application artworks, the application guide and three frames from the video

Acceptance:
- The branch specification establishes #244E3D, the 4800 × 800 mm and 2400 × 600 mm fascia dimensions, and the branch-name hierarchy before application development; the application guide and presentation repeat these three facts, and both fascia artworks follow the specified dimensions and hierarchy.
- All ten application artworks retain the complete supplied basket-and-wordmark master, with its lettering, arrangement, proportions and ink colour intact. The application guide, video and presentation preserve that same master wherever the applications reappear; branch cues sit outside its visible bounds.
- The two fascias, directories, bag fronts, membership card fronts and window notices each display their corresponding branch name in words. Their paired examples in the application guide and presentation use the same branch-name hierarchy established in the specification.
- The Market Green directory lists Fresh produce, Bread & dairy, Pantry staples and Household refills in that order; the River Lane directory lists Fresh produce, Bread & dairy and Pantry staples in that order. The specification, application guide, video and presentation retain those branch assignments wherever departments appear.
- Both bag fronts carry Good food. Shared ownership.; both membership card fronts carry Cooperative member and Member 0042. Both window notices carry Everyone is welcome. Membership is optional., with Daily 08:00–20:00 for Market Green and Daily 09:00–19:00 for River Lane; the guide and presentation preserve this wording in their application examples.
- The 10-second video follows the fascia, directory and bag sequence and ends with Good food. Shared ownership. The presentation contains at least eight pages, all ten application artworks, the specification facts, examples from the four-page application guide and three frames from that video.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
